application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Creation of a one-way link road between Syon Park and London Road, including associated engineering operations, earthworks, drainage and landscaping.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (N01-CC-SD- Transport Response Note D2 (191119) dated November 2019, unnumbered Carriageway plan, Tree Survey, Historic Environment and Landscape Appraisal dated November 2019, Ecological Impact Assessment dated December 2019, DD/001 Rev A, Historic environment assessment dated 22/11/2019, Transport Statement dated July 2019, Planning, Design and Access Statement dated December 2019. Received: 04/12/2020.
Planning Statement Addendum dated March 2020, Stage 1 Road Safety Audit dated March 2020, Road Safety Audit Response Report N04-CC-RSA Response, N02-CC-SD-Hounslow Highways Response D2 (200213) dated February 2020. Received: 24/03/2020.
Joint letter from Northumberland Estates, Hilton London Syon Park, Snakes and Ladders and Buttercups Nursery dated 02 October 2020, DD/100 Rev D. Received: 02/10/2020 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of the hereby approved development the Root Protection Zone for the London Plane and Oriental Plane trees as shown on the submitted tree survey shall be identified. The identified Root protection zone shall be maintained for the duration of the works and shall be kept clear of vehicles, materials and other items which may cause damage.

Condition : 4 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below. 

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until a stage 1 written scheme of investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing.  For land that is included within the WSI, no development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI, and the programme and methodology of site evaluation and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works.

If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified by stage 1 then for those parts of the site which have archaeological interest a stage 2 WSI shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing.  For land that is included within the stage 2 WSI, no development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed stage 2 WSI which shall include:
A.The statement of significance and research objectives, the programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works B.If appropriate, details of road construction to preserve archaeological remains in-situ C.The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication & dissemination and deposition of resulting material. This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the stage 2 WSI.
Condition : 6 - The approved link road shall only permit vehicles to travel northwards.  No vehicles shall be permitted to use the link road in a southerly direction.
Condition : 7 - Prior to the use commencing the lining and signage shown on drawing number DD/100 Rev D shall be installed and retained in good condition thereafter.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the use commencing, details of how the existing gate fronting London Road and the two additional gates approved, which serve the link road and the hotel servicing area, shall be operated shall be submitted to the local planning authority.  These details shall include measures to: prevent vehicles queuing on London Road to access the hotel servicing area; minimise the duration that the gate is not fully closed; prevent outbound vehicles obstructing inbound vehicles; prevent vehicles accessing the approved link road from the north; and limit access to the hotel servicing and staff parking area to legitimate users only.  The gates shall thereafter be operated in compliance with the Plan.

Condition : 9 - Prior to the use commencing, a Traffic Management Plan and an Event Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.  The Plans shall detail how the approved link road would be used, controlled and managed  day to day (by the different uses on the park grounds) and during events to ensure that vehicles exiting the site do not block traffic flow on London Road, do not obstruct pedestrians and cyclist movements on London Road, and do not prejudice highway safety.  The Plans shall also include, but not be limited to, active monitoring of the gates, their traffic flows, and a record of refused entries, with the results made available to the council on request.  The Plans shall remain in force for the lifetime of the development and shall be adapted to address any identified problems or council's concerns.

Condition : 10 - Prior to the use commencing, a scheme to improve cyclists' comfort, safety, and wayfinding through the park shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The scheme shall include, as a minimum, details of lighting of the route and speed hump improvements. Prior to discharging the condition the applicant shall liaise with the route improvement team to agree the details and the timeframe.
